key_insight: FLKit is an open, role-aware onboarding toolkit that helps multidisciplinary health and life sciences teams start federated learning projects with clearer guidance across governance, infrastructure, wrangling, and analysis.
clinical_relevance: It may lower setup barriers for privacy-preserving collaborative research in clinically sensitive settings by giving clinical, legal, governance, and technical stakeholders a shared starting point.
method: Modeled on the ELIXIR Research Data Management Kit
Built by a multidisciplinary core team with consortium milestone reviews and roadmap input
Grounded through interviews with external practitioners and organized into four lifecycle stages plus 11 role-specific entry points
evidence_signal: The abstract reports that FLKit expanded from its December 2024 demo to 39 pages across eight sections and now includes seven FL Stories covering multiple ongoing and completed projects.
watch_item: As an onboarding toolkit rather than a validated clinical system, its usefulness will depend on local adoption, upkeep, and how well its guidance fits each organization’s governance and technical stack.
paper_title: Development and Design of FLKit: A Structured Onboarding Toolkit for Federated Learning in Health and Life Sciences
